text: {"name":"l2c_ccb_init","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Initializes the indexed L2CAP channel control block and invokes its preparation routine with mode 1.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"a1":"ccb_index","v1":"ccb","result":"prepare_result"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":136,"meaning":"Initialized to max(0, the 16-bit value at offset 184 minus 1)."},{"offset":138,"meaning":"Initialized to max(0, the 16-bit value at offset 184 minus 2)."},{"offset":140,"meaning":"Initialized to max(0, the 16-bit value at offset 184 minus 3)."},{"offset":142,"meaning":"Cleared during initialization."},{"offset":148,"meaning":"Set to 0x10000 during initialization."},{"offset":152,"meaning":"Set to 5 after the preparation call."},{"offset":154,"meaning":"Cleared after the preparation call."},{"offset":164,"meaning":"Set to the low byte of the value at offset 184 minus 4."},{"offset":166,"meaning":"Cleared during initialization."},{"offset":184,"meaning":"16-bit source value used to derive initial values at offsets 136, 138, 140, and 164."},{"offset":190,"meaning":"Set to 0xFFFF as an initialization sentinel."}]}
